text:
[issue by Bopkasen]
### Steps to Reproduce the Crash

Based on the log file you provided, the problem with JEI is a hard code conflict with the Create mod (create-1.21.1-6.0.10.jar).

The critical crash error preventing JEI from indexing ingredients on world join is:

`java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: An interpreter is already registered for this: create:potion`

Why this is happening:

Both Create and another active mod are trying to register a sub-type interpreter for fluid potions (`create:potion`) inside the JEI registry map simultaneously. Java does not allow double-registrations on the same hook, forcing JEI to throw an `IllegalArgumentException` and lock up.

### Mod Pack URL (Optional)

_No response_

### Mod Pack Version (Optional)

_No response_

### Extra Notes (Optional)

Codename Ancient Builder X3 preparing a modpack for a server host owner expecting 50+ players to play this

### Crash Report

https://gist.github.com/Bopkasen/3d5a2e8de1fe59048ff37fb3fa1e43bb

How to Fix It

Fix 1: Step down your primary JEI version (Recommended)You are currently running jei-1.21.1-neoforge-19.56.0.441.jar. The 19.56.x branch altered how custom fluid registries are handled.

Close your game entirely.

Navigate to your ATLauncher instance folder: 📂 config/almostunified/unification/.Open the mods/ directory and delete jei-1.21.1-neoforge-19.56.0.441.jar.

Download and install Just Enough Items (JEI) version 19.21.0.166 (or any build in the stable 19.21.x milestone branch for 1.21.1). 

This step-down will safely parse the duplicate fluid tags without crashing the engine.

Fix 2: Add Create Potions to your Almost Unified Exclusions

Since the fluid collision is overlapping with your unification data maps, you can use your common.json file that you configured earlier to make the unification engine completely ignore the potion conflict:

Open 📂 config/almostunified/common.json.Locate the "ignored_items": [] array block.

Register the create potion item reference inside the brackets: "ignored_items": ["create:potion"].

[comment by mezz (owner)]
Thanks for the report!

The duplicate Create potion subtype message is not the crash. JEI logs that diagnostic and continues loading ingredients and recipes.

This is actually caused by JEI++, please try to update or remove it. 
Caused by this mixin into JEI: https://github.com/lingmu0/jei-plus-plus/blob/cd39b0123111bfe3bfe169f13a3010926943d1da/src/main/java/com/lingmu0/JeiPlusPlusMod/mixin/BookmarkOverlayMixin.java

It was later removed. I also removed all smaller JEI-related mods. EMI is installed as the primary mod, running alongside JEI as a secondary data bridge. However, the problem persisted, so I wrote a client script in KubeJS to hide specific fluids, including the Create potion. It is safe to say that this might be an issue with the Create mod itself. 

What I don't understand is why, even after three months, they continue to let the Create potion run wild. This investigation is ongoing.

If I learn anything new, I'll bring this up.

Thanks for the updated log. JEI loads successfully, and the final launch does not contain the Create potion diagnostic. The actual crash is caused by Enhanced Cats running server-only cat shelter logic in a client world. Please update or remove Enhanced Cats and test again; if it persists, also test without CatFighting.
EMI and EMI Accelerator are still installed, and EMI Accelerator reports a separate reload error. For a JEI report, please reproduce with JEI alone, without EMI/JEMI or EMI Accelerator. If you have a problem please open a new issue, do not keep re-using this closed issue.
